goal: Generate a 9:16 vertical debut profile card, suitable for direct use as the main visual for Weibo super topics, Bilibili dynamic images, and WeChat video account profile pages.

character.name: Sakura River, first day.
character.style: Japanese TV anime cel shading + two layers of cel shading
character.age_setting: 18 years old (set as virtual artist age)
character.appearance: Pink cherry double pigtails, mint green eyes, off-shoulder improved short flowing sleeves, waist cinch and calf socks with cherry blossom petal embroidery, wearing a tiny prop shaped like a wireless microphone by the ear
character.pose: Half-body illustration, body slightly turned 15°, one hand lightly lifting the sleeve corner, smiling amiably, one hand outstretched as if inviting into the livestreaming room

color_theme.accent_color: Small area with gold line edging.

debut_info.platform: Bilibili Live · WeChat Video Account Synchronization Initial Stream
debut_info.tags: #Initial Distribution #National V #Spring Sakura Group #See You at Nine

background.type: At dusk, weeping cherry trees by the river and silhouette of distant mountains and city, with the sky gradient from light purple to pale orange
background.fx: Gently falling glowing cherry petals + a few controllable particles, with a layer of softly focused petals in the foreground

layout.character_position: Slightly towards the center of the lower right, leaving 12% below for the brand logo and barcode position.
layout.info_block_position: Upper left vertical arrangement: stage name, premiere time, three lines of small text tags, text color dark brown or dark gray, white outline 1px
layout.logo_position: Bottom right small 'Spring Ming Society' original geometric letters and shapes, area not exceeding 4% of the frame

must_keep: The artist name, premiere date, and three platform fields are clearly readable and not significantly obscured by hair
Main colors are consistent with clothing colors and background cherry blossoms.
avoid: Use the precise shape of protected trademarks like Bilibili small TV
